prompts.rifle: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D side-view browser fighting-game sprite strip, NOT a poster. Reference image 1 is the exact approved right-facing RX-78-2 Gundam model. Draw the SAME cute compact armored robot, identical white/blue/red/yellow armor, green eye visor, V-fin, head/body proportions, black ink outlines and painted cel shading, consistent full-body height in ALL 8 frames. NEW action: beam rifle triple shot. One complete animation on a transparent RGBA canvas with EXACTLY 8 equal square slots arranged 4 columns by 2 rows, read left to right, no borders/text/scenery. Facing RIGHT in every slot, boots share the same bottom baseline, center hip stays fixed, roomy transparent gutters. Frames: 1 relaxed ready holding a dark grey rifle low in right hand; 2 bring rifle up with both hands; 3 settle aiming straight right, knees braced; 4 fully aim and steady barrel horizontal; 5 fire pose leaning slightly back from recoil; 6 recoil recovery still aiming right; 7 lower rifle toward ready; 8 same relaxed ready as frame 1. Draw a real recognizable beam rifle with long barrel, not a human gun. Left forearm may have a small red Gundam shield but keep the rifle silhouette clear. Do not draw any beam, muzzle flash, particles or detached effects: these are separate layers in the game. Only ONE complete robot in each cell, no duplicates or ghost limbs. No cropping of feet, fin, backpack or rifle. Match reference silhouette faithfully.
prompts.saber: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D side-view fighting-game sprite strip. Reference is the approved RX-78-2 Gundam model: preserve EXACT cute compact white robot proportions, blue chest, yellow vents/V-fin, red waist/boots, black mechanical joints, green visor, cel-painted inked shading. EXACTLY 8 complete robot frames in equal square slots, 4 columns x 2 rows, transparent RGBA background, left-to-right reading order. Every robot faces RIGHT. Same size, planted boot baseline and hip anchor across cells. Action: beam saber combination, a short hilt with a luminous PINK straight blade (not blue, not a katana). 1 ready with hilt down; 2 ignite straight pink blade while drawing arm back; 3 wind up saber above right shoulder, braced knees; 4 apex of anticipation with blade raised high; 5 wide downward-forward diagonal slash, blade reaches right, low attacking stance; 6 reverse upward-forward cut, distinct arm pose and straight blade points up-right; 7 finishing extended slash forward, knees flexed; 8 recover to ready with saber lowered. ONE robot per cell, no extra arms, no afterimages. Allow a little foot/body rotation for weight while facing right; identical head/armor design throughout. Rifle put away. Small red shield on far left forearm. The blade is attached to the held hilt in every visible sword frame. No detached particles or broad slash arcs: those are separate effects. Ample transparent gutters around fin, boots and extended sword. No scenery, floor, text or grid lines.
prompts.rifleFx: Use case: stylized-concept. An actual TRANSPARENT PNG production sprite sheet, NOT a graphic with a colored background. 8 isolated fighting-game energy effects in 4 columns x 2 rows of equal square slots on a 2:1 landscape canvas. Empty pixels have alpha ZERO. Wide completely clear gutters between every effect, no pink fog, NO background glow clouds, no colored panels, no shadows. Hand-painted crisp anime arcade style, vivid hot pink/magenta outer energy, brilliant white cores. Only the compact effect silhouette glows at its edges. Frame1 tiny round ignition star. Frame2 concentrated muzzle starburst. Frame3 muzzle flare extending to the RIGHT. Frames4,5,6: the SAME horizontal rightward rifle energy bolt with a long white core, magenta outer rim, pointed bright tip at RIGHT and short flame tail at LEFT; slightly varied plasma flicker over these three frames, fully contained inside each separate cell. Frame7 circular large impact star with jagged white rays and pink edge, frame8 fading scattered tiny impact sparks. NO robot, NO gun, no text, no labels, no border, no checkerboard. Each effect centered in its cell; nothing crosses into neighboring cells. Keep 15 percent padding in every slot; do not stretch a single beam across multiple cells.
prompts.saberFx: Use case: stylized-concept. Actual transparent RGBA PNG production sprite animation, exact 8 isolated effects in a 4 columns x 2 rows square-slot grid on a 2:1 wide canvas. Background and gutters must be completely transparent alpha ZERO; no colored haze panels, no pink fog wash, no scenery, no shadows.
